every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 keeps the active 3D machines mostly clear of the left-hand card across frames 1-9 (with only minor corner overlap in frame 5), whereas Site 2 repeatedly hides background 3D machines directly behind the text card in frames 6, 7, and 8.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 2's linear left-to-right assembly line—moving from the Containment Gate (frames 3-5) to the Artifact Store (frame 6), Content Anchor (frames 7-8), and full pipeline handoff (frame 9)—makes the data lifecycle much easier to follow than Site 1's clustered machine layout.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 2's hero machines in frames 1-8 feature closer framing, richer metallic bevels and wear, clearer cast shadows, and grounded floor boundary lines compared to Site 1's smaller, more distant models in frames 1-3 and 9.

type_and_layout.reason: Both sites share nearly identical typographic systems, dark technical cards, top progress navigation, and left-aligned layouts across frames 1-9, though Site 1 drops the text card completely during transitions in frames 4 and 7 while Site 2 keeps a card present in every frame.

overall.reason: Site 2 better fulfills the request to visualize how Straitjacket works through a clear, well-crafted, step-by-step 3D pipeline from log flood containment to multi-harness handoff.
